configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: firstName
configurable_props.label: First Name
configurable_props.description: First name of an employee (max length = 255). If an existing employee matches your `FirstName` and `LastName` then you will receive an error.

configurable_props.name: lastName
configurable_props.label: Last Name
configurable_props.description: Last name of an employee (max length = 255). If an existing employee matches your `FirstName` and `LastName` then you will receive an error.

configurable_props.name: status
configurable_props.label: Status
configurable_props.description: Current status of an employee - see contact status [types](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/types#ContactStatuses)

configurable_props.name: externalLink
configurable_props.label: External Link
configurable_props.description:
Link to an external resource, for example, an employee record in an external system. You can specify the URL element.
The description of the link is auto-generated in the form "Go to <App name>". <App name> refers to the [Xero application](https://api.xero.com/Application) name that is making the API call.
